title: demo-api HTTP 500 on /error endpoint
summary: Flask demo-api returning HTTP 500 errors on GET /error. Random exceptions include ConnectionRefusedError for Redis, TimeoutError, MemoryError, and ValueError for invalid JSON.
root_cause: Unhandled exceptions in /error route. Application raises random errors without try/catch. Redis connection refused when cache layer is down.
fix: Add error handling middleware. Check Redis connectivity before cache operations. Implement circuit breaker for downstream dependencies. Add health check for Redis at startup.

title: demo-api Redis connection refused
summary: demo-api traces show ConnectionRefusedError: Redis connection refused on error endpoint. Service cannot reach Redis cache at localhost:6379.
root_cause: Redis instance not running or wrong host/port configured. Application attempts cache read without connection pool validation.
fix: Verify Redis is running. Update REDIS_URL env var. Add connection retry with exponential backoff. Fall back to in-memory cache when Redis unavailable.

title: demo-api request timeout after 30s
summary: demo-api returning TimeoutError: Request timeout after 30s. Downstream service or database query exceeding timeout threshold.
root_cause: Slow downstream dependency or missing query timeout. Connection pool may be exhausted waiting for available connections.
fix: Increase httpx/requests timeout for known slow endpoints. Add query timeout on database connections. Check downstream service health and scale if needed.

title: demo-api MemoryError unable to allocate
summary: demo-api hit MemoryError: Unable to allocate 2GB during request processing. Pod or container may be OOM killed.
root_cause: Memory leak or oversized payload processing. Large object allocation without streaming or pagination.
fix: Profile memory usage with py-spy. Stream large responses instead of buffering. Set Kubernetes memory limits and enable HPA. Fix leak in request handler.

title: demo-api invalid JSON payload ValueError
summary: demo-api raising ValueError: Invalid JSON payload on POST requests. Client sending malformed JSON or wrong Content-Type header.
root_cause: Missing request body validation. Application parses JSON without schema validation or error handling.
fix: Add pydantic/marshmallow request validation. Return HTTP 400 with clear error message for invalid payloads. Log malformed request samples for debugging.

title: demo-api intermittent database connection timeout
summary: demo-api /flaky endpoint shows intermittent database connection timeout. 30% of requests fail with connection errors.
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion or network instability. Intermittent failures suggest race condition or pool sizing issue.
fix: Increase database connection pool size. Add connection health checks. Implement retry logic with jitter for transient failures.

title: API gateway 502 bad gateway errors
summary: API gateway returning 502 Bad Gateway when upstream demo-api returns 500. Load balancer marking backend as unhealthy.
root_cause: Upstream service errors propagate as gateway failures. No graceful degradation when backend is failing.
fix: Add retry with circuit breaker at gateway. Configure health check endpoints. Return cached responses for read-only routes during outages.

title: SSL certificate expired on demo-api ingress
summary: HTTPS requests to demo-api failing with certificate verify failed. TLS certificate expired and not auto-renewed.
root_cause: cert-manager or Let's Encrypt renewal failed. Certificate not monitored with expiry alerts.
fix: Renew SSL certificates via cert-manager. Set up cert expiry monitoring alerts 30 days before expiration. Verify DNS challenge configuration.
